ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

2. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

3. Solve for x: x + 8 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 7
   C. 15
   D. 8

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 12

5. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 32

6. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

7. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 13

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

9. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 3
   C. 17
   D. 15

11. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 17

12. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 14

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

15. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 9

16. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 1
   C. 9
   D. 21

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
